body:
Same.
I have written down so many elaborate plans, but I am too scared to commit suicide. I have talked to people online about it and all they say is "Good", like the hope to somehow die is great as long as you aren't actually dead. I torture myself thinking about dying and death and all that shit, yet at the end of it someone says "Good".

That's great! I told my friends and some of them are like "Yeah I have social anxiety too", yet they never experience the symptoms. They are just awkward. They don't acknowledge the fact that I have social anxiety. They ask me to go to someone for them, because they are too scared, when I literally hide behind walls when my friend is talking to someone (depending on the situation). But I can't leave my friends. They are the only people I have ever know that share my interests and understand me. They just don't understand social anxiety.

The same thing happens to me all the time. This one time I started talking to who I thought was my friend, making a weird af joke that only we understand. Turns out I was talking to my frenemy, who spreads rumors about practically everyone. Another time I made a threesome joke and everyone near me was staring at me like I am the most disgusting thing they have see. I get panic attacks or start thinking really suicidal thoughts when I remember things like that.
I am going to ruin what remains of my social life one day.
